```{r}
type <- rep(c("A", "B", "C", "D", "E"), times=6)
weight <- c(
  3.2, 4.5, 5.1, 2.8, 6.3,
  4.1, 3.7, 6.2, 3.6, 5.9,
  3.8, 4.1, 4.9, 3.2, 6.1,
  4.3, 3.9, 5.0, 2.9, 5.7,
  5.1, 3.5, 5.3, 3.8, 6.5,
  4.8, 4.0, 5.4, 3.7, 6.0)

df <- data.frame(type, weight)
```

```{r}
boxplot(weight ~ type, col=viridis::cividis(n=5))
```

# Diet effects: 
```{r}
mean <- tapply(weight, type, mean)
effect <- mean - mean(weight)
effect
```

# 
```{r}
model <- aov(weight ~ type, data=df)
summary(model)
```
